sources.label: Morphe-Patches für die Müllkalender-App: Tonnenart im Kalender anzeigen und Push
sources.author: Müllkalender
patch_list: Adds a switch to the "Extra Einstellungen (patched)" page to get a push notification once for every new announcement of the waste collection (cancellations, delays). The app checks every 30 minutes in the background.

Adds the waste type(s) and bin color(s) of the pickup day to the title of exported calendar events (e.g. "Müllabholung – Wertstoffe 🟡 (Street)") and adds an "Extra Einstellungen (patched)" page with a switch to turn this off. Events alread…
